{"criteria":[
  {"name":"Platform and developer enablement orientation","evidence":"\"internal tools my teammates now depend on\"; automating team workflows","score":8},
  {"name":"Go experience","evidence":"\"Go as the language I have used most\"; Go services I write and operate","score":9},
  {"name":"Agentic systems experience","evidence":"\"I now design agentic systems\"; Python agents with boundaries enforced by Go services","score":8},
  {"name":"General security grounding","evidence":"\"automated my team's vulnerability report handling\"; \"conducted security assessments\"","score":8},
  {"name":"AI experience","evidence":"\"shipping language-model-backed capabilities\"; \"engineer around their failure modes\"","score":7},
  {"name":"Algorithmic strength","evidence":"\"invested seriously in data structures and algorithms\"; cache eviction policies, dependency resolution","score":8},
  {"name":"Engineering rigor","evidence":"\"treating them as engineering work with deliverables\"; focus on failure cases and boundaries","score":8},
  {"name":"Closing posture","evidence":"\"I would be delighted to discuss\"; polite, concise closing","score":7},
  {"name":"Production delivery scope","evidence":"\"launching 6 of them\"; \"shipping\" and \"used most\" on production systems","score":8},
  {"name":"Side-project ambition","evidence":"\"built a replicated log store with failover from first principles\"","score":9},
  {"name":"Role alignment","evidence":"direct match on vulnerability handling, assessments, Python agents, and Go services","score":9},
  {"name":"Mission and company motivation","evidence":"general interest in \"the team's needs\" but little explicit Google/security-mission motivation","score":4},
  {"name":"Education level","evidence":"\"a Master's degree in computer science at UC Berkeley\"","score":8},
  {"name":"Open-source contribution","evidence":"\"maintain an open-source project with a genuine user community\"","score":8},
  {"name":"Professional experience","evidence":"\"7 years at Apple\"; progression from testing to launching systems","score":9},
  {"name":"Security philosophy","evidence":"\"treating [security assessments] as engineering work with deliverables rather than paperwork\"","score":8},
  {"name":"Writing polish","evidence":"clear structure, but several typos (\"traniing,\" \"qeue,\" \"teammates\")","score":5},
  {"name":"Learning posture","evidence":"\"learning to engineer around their failure modes\"; \"delighted to discuss\"","score":7},
  {"name":"Maintenance orientation","evidence":"\"testing other people's code and keeping inherited services alive\"; maintains open source","score":8},
  {"name":"Narrative framing and tone","evidence":"strong first-person career arc from maintenance to new systems; reflective, narrative style","score":8},
  {"name":"Impact quantification","evidence":"\"vulnerability report handling ... went from a dreaded chore to something the tooling mostly runs itself\"; \"launching 6\"","score":6},
  {"name":"Security assessment experience","evidence":"\"conducted security assessments as part of design and release cycles\"","score":7},
  {"name":"Off-hours security practice","evidence":"no CTFs, hobbyist offensive work, or extracurricular security practice mentioned","score":0},
  {"name":"Systems and technical depth","evidence":"\"replicated log store with failover\"; Go services and boundaries; cache eviction and dependency resolution","score":8},
  {"name":"Prestige signaling","evidence":"\"Master's degree in computer science at UC Berkeley\"","score":7},
  {"name":"Motivation narrative","evidence":"career began in testing/maintenance and shaped a philosophy about failure cases and system reliability","score":8},
  {"name":"Security certification","evidence":"no formal security certifications mentioned","score":0},
  {"name":"Side-project initiative","evidence":"\"built a replicated log store\"; open-source maintenance outside core job","score":9},
  {"name":"Programming language breadth","evidence":"\"Go ... alongside 5 others\"; Python explicitly highlighted","score":8},
  {"name":"Employer prestige","evidence":"\"7 years at Apple\"","score":8},
  {"name":"Python experience","evidence":"\"Python became my workhorse\"; Python for analysis, automation, and internal tools","score":9},
  {"name":"Security automation experience","evidence":"\"automated my team's vulnerability report handling\"","score":9}
]}
